intro: Gold mining and money from workers abroad are the pillars of Kyrgyzstan's economy.

chapters.title: Gold
text: The Kumtor gold mine, high in the mountains, produces a big share of exports.

chapters.title: Other work
text: Farming, herding, trade with China and tourism to Issyk-Kul are important. Money sent home by workers in Russia equals a large share of the economy.

keyTerms.meaning: Money sent home by people working abroad.

cardGroups.title: Made in Kyrgyzstan
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Kyrgyzstan makes and sells to the world.
